Meta cell compactness in a diffusion map

calc_meta_cell_compactness.Rd

Scores a meta cell assignment for compactness, i.e. the mean variance across the diffusion components over the cells of each meta cell. Lower is better. Unlike calc_manifold_metrics(), this works on any assignment, so meta cells generated outside bixverse (or on a different object) can be scored against an existing diffusion map.

Usage

calc_meta_cell_compactness(dcs, assignment)

Arguments

dcs

Numeric matrix. The diffusion map coordinates, cells x components, for example S7::prop(object, "other_data")$dcs after calc_diffusion_coordinates(). Its rows follow the used_cells of the kNN object the diffusion map was built from.

assignment

Atomic vector of length nrow(dcs) with the meta cell of each row of dcs. NA marks cells that belong to no meta cell. Overlapping meta cells (hdWGCNA-style) cannot be expressed this way; use calc_manifold_metrics() for those.

Value

Named numeric vector with one compactness value per meta cell, named and ordered like split() orders assignment.

References

Persad, et al., Nat Biotechnol, 2023

Examples

set.seed(1L)
dcs <- matrix(rnorm(200L), ncol = 2L)
assignment <- rep(sprintf("mc_%i", 1:10), each = 10L)
calc_meta_cell_compactness(dcs, assignment)
#>      mc_1     mc_10      mc_2      mc_3      mc_4      mc_5      mc_6      mc_7 
#> 0.6694486 0.8578757 0.6948285 0.5725448 0.5120067 0.9328036 0.9981734 1.2029001 
#>      mc_8      mc_9 
#> 0.5507736 0.7109698
